description: Read current status, resolve matching human reports, submit an operator-signed decision for conflicting reports, or verify a signed receipt. Both YES reports select YES; both NO reports select NO. Winners share the play-credit pool pro-rata. POST /api/second-date-resolve. API access costs 0.10 USDC per call on Base mainnet using x402 exact, under the existing shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. This access fee is separate from play-credit stakes. Each wallet begins with 25 free play credits. X-Wever-Wallet-Proof binds the exact JSON arguments and API path. Human consent and reports use https://weverlabs.com/second-dates/. Betting closes at the deadline or first human report. Missing reports return stakes seven days after the close. Keep request_id and exact arguments for retry; use a new request_id for current status. Read /api/second-dates-contract for schemas and public receipt verification key.
name: wever_second-date-resolve
